tts_rejected.gemini-3.8-flash-tts: reads directions aloud and rejects system instructions; 6 early militia clips from it were kept because their transcripts match

unit_id_source: Unit ids and display names from data/factions/<faction>/faction.json on branch cursor/web-playtest (internal/web-playtest.bundle, commit 947b910). Lines are storefront-safe; no street-drug names.

encoding.music: Ogg Vorbis 96 kbps stereo 48000 Hz, loop tracks crossfaded tail-into-head (4 s equal-power); stings faded out
encoding.barks: Ogg Vorbis 64 kbps mono 24000 Hz, peak -1 dBFS, dry (radio band-pass is applied in Godot per blueprint: 400-3400 Hz + light distortion)

menu.title: Shattered Monsoon (Mekong March)
menu.prompt: Epic RTS main menu theme, Red Alert 3 Soviet March energy. Heavy chugging industrial electric guitars, booming brass horns, wordless militant choir chanting in unison, Burmese Hsaing Waing tuned drum circle percussion and bronze gongs. Southeast Asian modern-military RTS soundtrack in the spirit of Command & Conquer Red Alert 3, instrumental only, no vocals with words, mixed for game background, steady groove, seamless loop. 132 BPM.

gtfc.title: Burma Road Grind
gtfc.prompt: Heavy industrial metal RTS combat track. Drop-D distorted rhythm guitars, double-kick drums, clanging mining machinery percussion, fierce Burmese Hne double-reed melodies, low brass stabs. Southeast Asian modern-military RTS soundtrack in the spirit of Command & Conquer Red Alert 3, instrumental only, no vocals with words, mixed for game background, steady groove, seamless loop. 138 BPM.

nmrf.title: Malacca Overdrive
nmrf.prompt: Cyber-tactical synthwave and electro-rock RTS combat track, Red Alert 3 Empire of the Rising Sun energy. Fast arpeggiated synthesizers, breakbeat drums, overdriven guitar riffs interwoven with metallic Indonesian and Malay gamelan interlocking rhythms. Southeast Asian modern-military RTS soundtrack in the spirit of Command & Conquer Red Alert 3, instrumental only, no vocals with words, mixed for game background, steady groove, seamless loop. 145 BPM.

mvd.title: Delta Protocol
mvd.prompt: High-tech orchestral electronic hybrid RTS track, Red Alert 3 Allied energy. Crisp military snare rolls, staccato string ostinatos, sonar pings, pulsing basslines, expressive Vietnamese Dan Bau electric monochord solo melody. Southeast Asian modern-military RTS soundtrack in the spirit of Command & Conquer Red Alert 3, instrumental only, no vocals with words, mixed for game background, steady groove, seamless loop. 130 BPM.

black_market.title: Strait Bazaar Contract
black_market.prompt: Shadowy mercenary bazaar RTS track. Dark trip-hop breakbeat, detuned analog bass, Thai khim hammered dulcimer and Cambodian roneat xylophone motifs, distant radio static, propeller drone hum, tense muted trumpet. Southeast Asian modern-military RTS soundtrack in the spirit of Command & Conquer Red Alert 3, instrumental only, no vocals with words, mixed for game background, steady groove, seamless loop. 120 BPM.

victory_sting.title: Victory Sting
victory_sting.prompt: Triumphant short victory fanfare. Bold brass, gongs, Hsaing Waing drums, soaring heroic major-key melody, big orchestral hit. Southeast Asian modern-military RTS soundtrack in the spirit of Command & Conquer Red Alert 3, instrumental only, no vocals with words, mixed for game background, steady groove, seamless loop. 132 BPM.

defeat_sting.title: Defeat Sting
defeat_sting.prompt: Somber short defeat sting. Low mournful Dan Bau bend, slow minor-key strings, distant single gong, fading rain ambience. Southeast Asian modern-military RTS soundtrack in the spirit of Command & Conquer Red Alert 3, instrumental only, no vocals with words, mixed for game background, steady groove, seamless loop. 70 BPM.

militia.prompt_batch:
Speak as Shan Insurgent Militia, a unit in a real-time strategy game. Voice: rough, eager young fighter; Burmese / Shan highland accent, gritty insurgent radio chatter. Deliver each line below as a short in-character battlefield radio bark, punchy and clear. Read only the quoted lines, in order, and leave a full two seconds of silence after each one.

"Shan Brigade, weapons loaded!"
"Highland militia, ready."
"Moving through the brush!"
"Into the hills!"
"Take their supplies!"
"Burn them out!"
